UserStory: As the lead agent, I want to create a Polar checkout for a product, so that customers can purchase.
ExpectedBehavior: Accepts productId; resolves Firestore product; calls injected PolarClient.createCheckout(); returns checkoutUrl + checkoutId; NOT consequential (agent can call without approval).

UserStory: As the lead agent, I want to request approval before executing consequential actions, so that humans can review/block dangerous operations.
ExpectedBehavior: CONSEQUENTIAL_TOOLS = [deliver_release, initiate_payout, issue_sync_license, marketing_spend, publish_social_post, send_email_blast]; when approval context supplied, ApprovalGate blocks these tools; agent awaits adminApprove before retry; non-consequential tools pass through.

UserStory: As the lead agent, I want to write/update its working plan, so that complex multi-step tasks are coordinated.
ExpectedBehavior: Injected tool from harness; mutates PlanState; used to break down multi-step workflows; not gated.

UserStory: As a label analyst, I want to pull D2C sales metrics from Polar orders into analytics events for a period, so that I can measure sales performance.
ExpectedBehavior: Reads Firestore orders mirror; filters to paid orders; maps products to releases; emits units (value=1) + revenue_cents per order; idempotent on (orderId, metric); stores in admin-only analytics_events collection; read-only.

UserStory: As a label operator, I want to ingest streaming stats (streams/listeners/saves) from DSP, so that I can assess listener engagement.
ExpectedBehavior: Real stub reads DSP_STATS_API_TOKEN from env; throws without it; never invoked in tests; deterministic fake class included for gates; emits one event per metric.
Notes: Deterministic fake ingest tested; real path needs DSP_STATS_API_TOKEN at handoff.

UserStory: As a label analyst, I want to aggregate a period's analytics into a deterministic summary with rankings/growth, so that I can make data-driven decisions.
ExpectedBehavior: Pure function; sums events by source/metric; ranks releases by streams/revenue (desc, ties by releaseId asc); computes period-over-period growth (integer permille); deterministic; stores to insight_reports/{period}; read-only.

UserStory: As a label A&R team, I want deterministic proposals for next actions based on streaming/revenue patterns, so that I can prioritize creative strategy.
ExpectedBehavior: Pure function; overperformers (streams ge 1.5x avg) yield follow_up_single; underperformers (le 0.5x avg) yield marketing_push; top-revenue release yields deepen_d2c; all proposals inert (never trigger release/spend/payout); deterministic ordering; stores to anr_recommendations; read-only.

UserStory: As an agent, I want to schedule a release for DSP distribution, so that I can plan delivery.
ExpectedBehavior: Records a distributions/{releaseId} doc with status scheduled and the requested scheduledAt timestamp (ISO-8601). Verifies the release exists first. Does not deliver anything.

UserStory: As an agent, I want to prepare a release for distribution without delivering, so that I can verify its readiness.
ExpectedBehavior: Builds a DDEX ERN from the release/tracks/artist, validates it structurally (well-formed XML, required elements present), and reports READY to deliver or lists missing/invalid UPC/ISRC fields. Does NOT call the distributor.

UserStory: As a human approver via adminDeliverRelease, I want to deliver a release to DSPs after verifying it, so that music goes live.
ExpectedBehavior: Checks approved=true (throws APPROVAL_REQUIRED if false), runs compliance gate (aiGenerated/provenance per track/ownership splits sum 100/ACTIVE artist agreement with AI consent), builds and validates DDEX ERN, submits to injected DistributorClient, mirrors deliveryId/status into distributions/{releaseId} record.

UserStory: As the system, I want to read a release's distribution status, so that I can report on delivery lifecycle.
ExpectedBehavior: Returns distributions/{releaseId} record (admin-only, never public) or null if absent. Carries releaseId, status, scheduledAt?, deliveryId?, deliveredAt?, updatedAt.

UserStory: As the system, I want to poll the distributor for an updated status, so that I can track delivery progress.
ExpectedBehavior: Reads distributions/{releaseId}, throws if no deliveryId exists yet, polls the injected DistributorClient.status(deliveryId), merges the refreshed status back into the record.

UserStory: As the system, I want to construct a DDEX ERN XML package from a release, so that it can be submitted to a distributor.
ExpectedBehavior: Validates release has valid UPC/barcode, all tracks have valid ISRCs, any supplied ISWCs are valid. Builds deterministic ERN-style XML with MessageHeader, ResourceList (SoundRecordings per track), ReleaseList (Release with UPC/title/artist/credits/aiDisclosure), and DealList stub. Throws before producing XML on any validation failure.

UserStory: As the system, I want to verify an ERN package is well-formed, so that invalid messages never reach the distributor.
ExpectedBehavior: Parses ERN XML with fast-xml-parser, returns {ok, problems[]} if well-formed and required elements present (NewReleaseMessage root, MessageHeader, ResourceList with ge 1 SoundRecordings each with ISRC, ReleaseList/Release). Does not throw; returns validation result.

UserStory: As the system, I want to test distribution without a live DSP account, so that gates run offline.
ExpectedBehavior: Records each deliver() call with deliveryId/ernXml/meta/status in memory; returns synthetic delivery id + initialStatus (default accepted). status() call advances recorded delivery to refreshedStatus (default delivered) to simulate the release going live.

UserStory: As the operator, I want to deliver ERN packages to a live distributor, so that music ships to DSPs.
ExpectedBehavior: POSTs ERN XML to configured base URL (env DISTRIBUTOR_BASE_URL) with Bearer token (env DISTRIBUTOR_API_TOKEN). Throws without token. status() GET polls delivery id. Only invoked in production; never in unit/emulator gates.
Notes: FakeDistributorClient (DST-08) fully tested via distribution.emulator; real client needs DISTRIBUTOR_API_TOKEN at handoff.

UserStory: As a caller, I want to check service health and harness version, so that I know the deployment is running.
ExpectedBehavior: GET /health; returns {ok, service, harnessVersion}; no auth required.
Notes: gatewayInfo() covered; thin onRequest health wrapper not invoked by a test.

UserStory: As a customer, I want to create a Polar checkout via the public API, so that I can purchase.
ExpectedBehavior: Callable {productId} -> {checkoutUrl, checkoutId}; no auth required; calls PolarSdkClient; DEPLOYED.
Notes: createCheckoutForProduct covered via polar.emulator (FakePolarClient); onCall wrapper + live PolarSdkClient not invoked (needs POLAR_ACCESS_TOKEN).

UserStory: As Polar, I want to notify of paid orders via webhook, so that entitlements are granted.
ExpectedBehavior: onRequest receiver; verifies Standard Webhooks signature (POLAR_WEBHOOK_SECRET bound); calls handlePolarWebhook; returns {handled}; DEPLOYED.
Notes: verifyWebhookSignature + handlePolarWebhook covered (polarWebhookSignature, polar.emulator); onRequest wrapper not invoked by a test.

UserStory: As a label admin, I want to pull D2C (Polar) orders into revenue events for a period, so that I have a local, offline source of truth for order-based income.
ExpectedBehavior: Reads Firestore orders mirror; filters to paid orders; maps products to releases; creates RevenueEvent records (id, source, grossCents, currency, occurredAt); idempotent on event id; stores in admin-only revenue_events collection.

UserStory: As a label operator, I want to ingest streaming/download income from a distributor, so that I account for non-D2C revenue.
ExpectedBehavior: Real stub reads DISTRIBUTOR_API_TOKEN from env; throws without it; never invoked in tests; deterministic fake class included for gates.
Notes: Deterministic fake ingest tested; real path needs DISTRIBUTOR_API_TOKEN at handoff.

UserStory: As a label operator, I want to ingest publishing income from a PRO/MLC, so that I account for performance/mechanical royalties.
ExpectedBehavior: Real stub reads PRO_API_TOKEN from env; throws without it; never invoked in tests; deterministic fake class included for gates.
Notes: Deterministic fake ingest tested; real path needs PRO_API_TOKEN at handoff.

UserStory: As a finance system, I want to split a release's gross revenue across payees using largest-remainder allocation, so that no cents are lost or created.
ExpectedBehavior: Splits totalCents across ownership splits using Hamilton method; guarantees sum = totalCents exactly; rejects invalid inputs (non-integer/negative/splits not summing to 100); returns PayeeShare array.

UserStory: As a finance system, I want to recoup an artist's outstanding advance from their royalty share, so that the label recovers fronted costs before payout.
ExpectedBehavior: Computes recoupment = min(available, outstanding); updates account.recoupedCents; never negative; carries leftover advance; pure function with persisted variant.

UserStory: As a label admin, I want a per-artist/per-period statement reconciling gross to net payable, so that I have an auditable record of each artist's earnings.
ExpectedBehavior: Finds artist's releases; gathers period revenue events; splits each release gross via ownershipSplits; takes artist payee share (cent-exact); attributes to sources proportionally; applies deductions then recoupment; reconciles gross - deductions - recoupment = net; persists to royalty_statements; idempotent on (artistId, period).

UserStory: As a label admin, I want to propose a payout for an artist's statement, so that approval can happen before execution.
ExpectedBehavior: Reads statement; validates artistId match; creates Payout record with status proposed; amount = statement net; no money moves; stores in admin-only payouts collection; idempotent on statementId.

UserStory: As a label admin, I want to execute an approved payout, so that the payment process begins.
ExpectedBehavior: CONSEQUENTIAL action gated by ApprovalGate via initiate_payout tool; reaches DOCUMENTED STUB only (no payment SDK); marks status executed-stub; records timestamp + stub note; no money moved; requires operator payment creds at handoff.

UserStory: As a label owner, I want to create an artist profile, so that I can manage their releases.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:37). Accepts artist id/name/bio/photoPath/links; verifies admin auth; persists to artists collection; returns Artist.

UserStory: As a label owner, I want to create a release for an artist, so that I can plan distribution and marketing.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:38). Accepts release id/artistId/title/catalogNumber/type/releaseDate; verifies admin; sets aiGenerated=true; persists to releases collection.

UserStory: As a label owner, I want to create a sellable product linked to a release, so that customers can purchase.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:39). Accepts product id/type/title/priceCents/currency/releaseId/polarProductId/polarPriceId; verifies admin; persists to products collection.

UserStory: As a label owner, I want to view all paid orders, so that I can track D2C sales.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:40). Verifies admin; reads and returns all orders (read-only).

UserStory: As a label owner, I want to set UPC, credits, and per-track ISRCs, so that distribution metadata is complete.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:63). Accepts releaseId + optional upc/credits/trackIsrcs; verifies admin; validates identifiers; persists to release + tracks; returns {release, tracks}.

UserStory: As a label owner, I want to set sensitive ownership splits for a release, so that royalties route correctly.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:64). Accepts releaseId + splits; verifies admin; validates splits sum to 100; writes ONLY to admin-only rights collection; returns RightsRecord.

UserStory: As a label owner, I want to upload a track master to private Storage, so that it is secured for distribution.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:66). Accepts trackId, masterPath, contentBase64; verifies admin; uploads to PRIVATE Storage; records in track_masters with content SHA-256; returns {trackId, masterPath, contentSha256}.

UserStory: As a label owner, I want to generate a 30s preview clip from the master, so that customers hear a sample.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:67). Accepts trackId, previewClipPath, masterContentBase64; verifies admin; encodes via injected encoder; uploads to PUBLIC Storage; updates track previewClipPath.

UserStory: As a label owner, I want to set AI-generation provenance for a track, so that buyers know it was AI-created.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:68). Accepts trackId, generator, model, disclosure, contentBase64; verifies admin; creates C2PA-style record with SHA-256 binding; persists to provenance collection.

UserStory: As a label owner, I want to schedule a release for distribution, so that it is queued for DSP delivery.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:41). Accepts releaseId, scheduledAt; verifies admin; validates release exists; persists DistributionRecord status scheduled (non-consequential).

UserStory: As a label owner, I want to deliver a scheduled release to DSPs, so that it is distributed.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:42). Accepts releaseId, approved=true (schema-required); verifies admin; checks DISTRIBUTOR_API_TOKEN bound at deploy; calls DdexDistributorClient; persists status delivered; no delivery without approval.

UserStory: As a label owner, I want to see distribution status for all releases, so that I know which are scheduled/delivered.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:43). Verifies admin; reads all DistributionRecords; joins with release titles; returns DistributionStatusRow[] (read-only).

UserStory: As a label owner, I want to view royalty statements by period/artist, so that I can track earnings.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:70). Verifies admin; optionally filters by artistId; reads and returns all RoyaltyStatements (read-only).

UserStory: As a label owner, I want to ingest revenue from Polar sales + optional fixtures, so that royalties are calculated.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:69). Accepts period, optional productReleaseMap/distributorEvents/proEvents; verifies admin; always pulls local Polar orders; optionally ingests deterministic fixtures; NO live revenue API called.

UserStory: As a label owner, I want to generate a per-artist royalty statement for a period, so that payouts are reconciled.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:71). Accepts artistId, period, optional deductionsCents/payeeName; verifies admin; computes net = gross - deductions; persists RoyaltyStatement.

UserStory: As a label owner, I want to propose a payout for a statement, so that the artist can be paid.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:72). Accepts artistId, statementId, optional currency; verifies admin; reads statement; creates Payout status proposed (no live payment).

UserStory: As a label owner, I want to register a composition in the publishing registry, so that it can be tracked for sync licensing.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:73). Accepts id, title, optional iswc/linkedIsrcs; verifies admin; validates identifiers; persists to PUBLIC works collection.

UserStory: As a label owner, I want to set sensitive writer splits for a composition, so that royalties route to writers.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:74). Accepts workId, splits; verifies admin; validates splits sum to 100; writes ONLY to admin-only work_splits collection.

UserStory: As a label owner, I want to register a writer's PRO/MLC affiliation, so that royalties can be collected.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:75). Accepts writerId, pro, optional ipi/memberId; verifies admin; checks PRO_API_TOKEN bound at deploy; calls injected ProRegistrar; persists ProAffiliation.

UserStory: As a label owner, I want to add a recording to the sync catalog, so that it is available for licensing.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:76). Accepts recordingId, workId, title, optional available; verifies admin; persists to PUBLIC sync_catalog collection.

UserStory: As a licensee, I want to request a sync license for a recording, so that it can be used in media.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:77). Accepts id, recordingId, workId, licensee, mediaType, territory, termMonths, feeCents; verifies admin; persists sync_licenses status requested.

UserStory: As a label owner, I want to verify a requested sync license is complete, so that I can issue it.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:78). Accepts licenseId; verifies admin; checks recording + work exist; updates status cleared.

UserStory: As a label owner, I want to issue a cleared sync license, so that the licensee can legally use the composition.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:79). Accepts licenseId, approved=true (schema-required); verifies admin; reads cleared license; stamps placeholder text; sets status issued; no issuance without approval.

UserStory: As a campaign operator, I want to plan a release campaign from the admin console, so that marketing is coordinated.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:48). Accepts releaseId, optional budgetCents/campaignId; verifies admin; expands template; persists campaign status planned.

UserStory: As a campaign operator, I want to schedule planned steps from the admin console, so that they fire autonomously.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:49). Accepts campaignId, baseTime, optional cadenceDays; verifies admin; schedules via injected scheduler; persists step times + status scheduled.

UserStory: As a campaign operator, I want to view all campaigns from the admin console, so that I can track status.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:50). Verifies admin; reads and returns all Campaign records (read-only).

UserStory: As a label owner, I want to publish a social post from the admin console, so that the release is announced.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:51). Accepts platform, message, optional assetPath, approved=true; verifies admin; checks SOCIAL_API_TOKEN bound at deploy; calls injected SocialChannel; logs marketing_events; no post without approval.

UserStory: As a label owner, I want to send an email blast from the admin console, so that subscribers are notified.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:52). Accepts segment, subject, body, approved=true; verifies admin; checks EMAIL_API_TOKEN bound at deploy; calls injected EmailChannel; logs marketing_events; no send without approval.

UserStory: As a label owner, I want to place paid ad spend from the admin console, so that the release is promoted.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:53). Accepts platform, budgetCents, currency, objective, approved=true; verifies admin; checks ADS_API_TOKEN bound at deploy; calls injected AdChannel; logs marketing_events; no spend without approval.

UserStory: As a label owner, I want to ingest analytics from Polar sales + optional DSP stats, so that performance is tracked.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:54). Accepts period, optional productReleaseMap/dspStats; verifies admin; always pulls Polar orders; optionally ingests deterministic DSP fixtures; NO live analytics API called.

UserStory: As a label owner, I want to generate insight reports on performance, so that I understand what resonates.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:55). Accepts period, optional priorPeriod; verifies admin; generates deterministic InsightReport (read-only); persists and returns.

UserStory: As a label owner, I want A&R recommendations (proposals only), so that I can guide creative decisions.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:56). Accepts period, optional priorPeriod; verifies admin; derives AnrRecommendation list; persists and returns (no consequential action triggered).

UserStory: As a label owner, I want to view stored A&R recommendations, so that I can track what was suggested.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:57). Verifies admin; reads and returns all AnrRecommendation records (read-only).

UserStory: As a label owner, I want to register an artist agreement, so that terms are recorded.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:58). Accepts artistId, termMonths, royaltyRatePct, ownershipNote, optional aiGenerationConsent/signedAt; verifies admin; persists ArtistAgreement status draft.

UserStory: As a label owner, I want to activate an artist agreement, so that it becomes binding.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:59). Accepts artistId; verifies admin; updates ArtistAgreement status active.

UserStory: As a label owner, I want to set binding license terms, so that custom legal wording is used.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:60). Accepts kind, bodyText; verifies admin; sets isPlaceholder=false; persists LicenseTerms.

UserStory: As a label owner, I want to run a pre-distribution compliance check, so that metadata is complete.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:61). Accepts releaseId; verifies admin; runs read-only validation (credits/identifiers/splits/provenance/agreements); returns ComplianceResult.

UserStory: As a label owner, I want to see which consequential agent actions are blocked pending approval, so that I can unblock them.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:45). Verifies admin; reads ApprovalRecord list; returns all with status pending (read-only).

UserStory: As a label owner, I want to approve a blocked agent action, so that it can execute on the next run.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:46). Accepts approvalId; verifies admin; updates ApprovalRecord status approved; the same (tool, args) call is then unblocked.

UserStory: As a label owner, I want to review a thread's full agent audit trail, so that I can see every action and decision.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:47). Accepts threadId; verifies admin; reads all AuditEntry records for the thread; returns in call order (read-only).

UserStory: As a label owner, I want to run the lead agent from the admin console with a prompt, so that it can autonomously execute label tasks.
ExpectedBehavior: EXPORTED (index.ts:81). Accepts prompt; verifies admin; checks ANTHROPIC_API_KEY bound at deploy; builds LabelAgent; invokes graph; returns transcript (every tool/approval-blocked call audited).

UserStory: As an agent, I want to create or overwrite an artist in the label catalog, so that the artist can be associated with releases.
ExpectedBehavior: Writes a world-readable artist doc (id, name, bio, photoPath, links) to the artists collection with set-with-id idempotence. Prunes undefined link fields.

UserStory: As an agent, I want to create a release linked to an artist, so that it can contain tracks and be distributed.
ExpectedBehavior: Writes a release doc (id, artistId, title, catalogNumber, type, releaseDate, aiGenerated=true) to the releases collection with set-with-id idempotence. Validates and normalizes UPC barcode if present.

UserStory: As an agent, I want to create a track on a release, so that it can be played and distributed.
ExpectedBehavior: Writes a PUBLIC track doc (id, releaseId, title, durationSec, previewClipPath) with no master path to the tracks collection; separately stores the PRIVATE masterPath in the admin-only track_masters collection via setTrackMaster.

UserStory: As an agent, I want to create a sellable product (music download), so that it can generate revenue.
ExpectedBehavior: Writes a product doc (id, type=music_download, title, priceCents, currency, releaseId?, polarProductId?, polarPriceId?) to the products collection with set-with-id idempotence.

UserStory: As an agent, I want to set a release's barcode and production credits, so that it can be properly identified in distribution.
ExpectedBehavior: Merges UPC/EAN barcode (validated with GS1 check digit) and production credits array onto the public release doc via Firestore merge. Throws on invalid UPC check digit.

UserStory: As an agent, I want to set a track's PUBLIC ISRC recording identifier, so that it can be identified in DDEX delivery and licensing.
ExpectedBehavior: Validates ISRC format (CC-XXX-YY-NNNNN) and normalizes it; merges the isrc field onto the public track doc via Firestore merge. Throws on invalid ISRC.

UserStory: As an agent, I want to set a release's ownership splits, so that royalties are correctly distributed.
ExpectedBehavior: Validates splits (non-empty set must sum to 100, each percent gt 0 and le 100) and writes ONLY to the admin-only rights/{releaseId} collection (never the public release doc). Throws on invalid splits.

UserStory: As an agent, I want to ingest a track's master audio, so that it can be previewed and distributed.
ExpectedBehavior: Validates master path (under masters/ with extension wav/flac/aiff) and bytes (non-empty), writes bytes to PRIVATE masters/ Storage via injected bucket, records the private path in admin-only track_masters collection, and returns the content SHA-256.

UserStory: As an agent, I want to generate a PUBLIC preview clip from a master, so that listeners can sample the track.
ExpectedBehavior: Validates preview path (under previews/), clips the master bytes using injected encoder, validates the preview bytes (non-empty, le 30s duration), writes preview to PUBLIC previews/ Storage, and sets the track's previewClipPath field.

UserStory: As an agent, I want to record a track's AI-provenance disclosure, so that listeners know it is AI-generated.
ExpectedBehavior: Writes a PUBLIC C2PA-style provenance record to provenance/{trackId} (admin-write, world-readable) with generator, model, disclosure, createdAt, and contentSha256 (binding the disclosure to the master bytes via SHA-256).

UserStory: As an agent, I want to list all mirrored Polar orders, so that I can report sales.
ExpectedBehavior: Returns a JSON array of all Order records from the admin-only orders collection (mirrored from Polar).

UserStory: As the system, I want to ensure only valid barcodes and recording identifiers enter the catalog, so that distribution cannot fail on bad metadata.
ExpectedBehavior: isValidISRC and isValidUPC check format and GS1 mod-10 check digits; normalizeISRC and normalizeUPC strip hyphens/spaces and uppercase; isValidISWC checks ISWC mod-10. All throw before any Firestore write.

UserStory: As the system, I want to ensure splits sum to 100, so that royalty distribution is correct.
ExpectedBehavior: validateSplits checks that each split's payee is non-empty, percent is 0 lt p le 100, and the total sums to 100 (epsilon 1e-9 for floats). Throws on any violation.

UserStory: As the system, I want to create a deterministic starter catalog, so that go-live testing is reproducible.
ExpectedBehavior: seedRootsUntold idempotently creates the Roots Untold artist, Foundation Stones EP (PRM-001, UPC 196633982100), three tracks with ISRCs and preview paths, private master paths, ownership splits (PlayReggaeMusic.ai 70%/Roots Untold 30%), three provenance records, a music_download product, and an ACTIVE artist agreement with AI-generation consent.

UserStory: As a legal team, I want to record an artist's contract term/royalty rate/ownership note/AI consent, so that compliance checks can verify proper authorization.
ExpectedBehavior: Validates artistId (non-empty), termMonths (positive integer), royaltyRatePct (0-100); creates ArtistAgreement with status draft + consent block (aiGenerationConsent bool, signedAt timestamp); stores in admin-only artist_agreements/{artistId}; idempotent; never public.

UserStory: As a legal team, I want to activate a draft agreement, so that it counts toward compliance gating.
ExpectedBehavior: Reads draft agreement; flips status to active; merges other fields untouched; returns updated record; throws if agreement missing; admin-only.

UserStory: As a label owner, I want to store binding license wording for a license kind, so that customers see legal terms (not placeholder).
ExpectedBehavior: Validates kind/bodyText non-empty; writes LicenseTerms with isPlaceholder=false, updatedAt; replaces placeholder; stores in admin-only license_terms/{kind}; idempotent.

UserStory: As a distribution system, I want to verify a release passes legal gates before DSP delivery, so that only compliant releases distribute.
ExpectedBehavior: Checks (a) AI-disclosure: release.aiGenerated=true + provenance for every track; (b) ownership splits exist and sum to 100; (c) active artist agreement with aiGenerationConsent=true; appends non-blocking WARNING for placeholder license; returns {compliant, issues[]}; hard failures block, warnings warn-only; read-only.

UserStory: As a label operator, I want to plan a marketing campaign for a release by expanding the template, so that the campaign has ordered steps.
ExpectedBehavior: Accepts releaseId + optional budgetCents; expands the deterministic template into 5 steps with status planned; persists to admin-only campaigns collection; returns campaign with id and steps in template order.

UserStory: As a campaign operator, I want to generate on-brand copy for a campaign step, so that the messaging is consistent and disclosed.
ExpectedBehavior: Accepts releaseId + step kind; deterministically generates templated copy for announce/preview/playlist_pitch/email/ad_spend, always including AI-generated disclosure; no LLM call.

UserStory: As a campaign operator, I want to schedule planned steps with a base time and cadence, so that steps fire autonomously.
ExpectedBehavior: Accepts campaignId, baseTime (ISO-8601), optional cadenceDays (default 1); computes each step firing time; schedules via injected Scheduler; persists step times + campaign status scheduled.

UserStory: As a label operator, I want to publish a social post to a platform, so that the release is announced publicly.
ExpectedBehavior: Accepts platform, message, optional assetPath; checks approval gate (CONSEQUENTIAL_TOOLS); calls injected SocialChannel.post(); no live post without approval.

UserStory: As a label operator, I want to send an email to an audience segment, so that subscribers are notified.
ExpectedBehavior: Accepts segment, subject, body; checks approval gate; calls injected EmailChannel.send(); no live send without approval.

UserStory: As a label operator, I want to place paid ad spend on a platform, so that the release gets promotional reach.
ExpectedBehavior: Accepts platform, budgetCents, currency, objective; checks approval gate; calls injected AdChannel.spend(); no live spend without approval.

UserStory: As a customer, I want to create a checkout for a music_download product, so that I can purchase it.
ExpectedBehavior: Accepts productId; resolves Firestore product; looks up polarProductId/polarPriceId; calls injected PolarClient.createCheckout(); returns checkoutUrl + checkoutId.

UserStory: As the Polar system, I want to notify of paid orders, so that entitlements are granted.
ExpectedBehavior: Receives Standard Webhooks event; verifies HMAC-SHA256 signature; extracts order data; calls handlePolarWebhook; persists paid order to orders collection; returns 200 {handled}.

UserStory: As a customer with a paid order, I want to download a track from my purchase, so that I own the audio file.
ExpectedBehavior: Accepts orderId, trackId; verifies order is PAID and unlocks the track's release; calls injected signer to mint time-limited GCS signed URL (default 15 min); returns url + disclosure + license text.

UserStory: As an agent, I want to register a composition in the publishing registry, so that it can be linked to recordings and licensed.
ExpectedBehavior: Writes a PUBLIC works/{id} doc (id, title, iswc?, linkedIsrcs[]) and never writer splits. Validates ISWC (if present) and each linked ISRC; normalizes and throws on invalid identifiers. Idempotent (set-with-id).

UserStory: As an agent, I want to set a composition's writer ownership, so that publishing royalties are correctly allocated.
ExpectedBehavior: Validates splits (non-empty set must sum to 100, each percent gt 0 and le 100) and writes ONLY to admin-only work_splits/{workId} collection (never public works doc). Throws on invalid splits.

UserStory: As an agent, I want to affiliate a writer with a PRO/MLC, so that they can collect performance/mechanical royalties.
ExpectedBehavior: Takes injected ProRegistrar (FakeProRegistrar in tests, RealProRegistrar in production), calls registrar.register(affiliation), persists the affiliation to admin-only pro_affiliations/{writerId} collection, returns registrar confirmation.

UserStory: As an agent, I want to advertise a recording for sync licensing, so that film/TV/game producers can license it.
ExpectedBehavior: Validates recording ISRC, writes a PUBLIC sync_catalog/{recordingId} entry (recordingId/ISRC, workId, title, available=true by default). Idempotent (set-with-id keyed by normalized ISRC).

UserStory: As an agent, I want to record an inbound sync-license request, so that I can track licensing asks without commitment.
ExpectedBehavior: Validates recordingId (ISRC), termMonths (positive integer), feeCents (non-negative integer), and writes sync_licenses/{id} doc with status requested. Makes no binding commitment. Idempotent (set-with-id).

UserStory: As an agent, I want to verify both master and composition halves are clearable, so that I can proceed to issuance safely.
ExpectedBehavior: Verifies license is requested status, checks MASTER (recording in sync_catalog AND available), checks COMPOSITION (underlying work exists). Throws if either half missing/unavailable. Advances to cleared without binding commitment.

UserStory: As a human approver via ApprovalGate, I want to issue a cleared sync license, so that it becomes a binding commitment.
ExpectedBehavior: Requires license status cleared. Stamps SYNC_LICENSE_PLACEHOLDER (owner to supply binding wording before go-live), sets status issued and issuedAt timestamp. Registered in CONSEQUENTIAL_TOOLS so ApprovalGate blocks it until human approval.

UserStory: As the system, I want to test PRO/MLC affiliation without a live account, so that gates run offline.
ExpectedBehavior: Records each register() call in memory; returns synthetic confirmationId (fake-pro-{pro}-{counter}) and registeredAt timestamp. Never makes network calls.

UserStory: As the operator, I want to register writer affiliations with a live PRO/MLC, so that writers can collect royalties.
ExpectedBehavior: Requires PRO_API_TOKEN from environment; throws loudly if token absent (fail loud rather than silent fail). Live registration logic deliberately not wired (owner-side at handoff per manifest).
Notes: FakeProRegistrar (PUB-08) tested; real registrar needs PRO_API_TOKEN at handoff.

UserStory: As a public visitor, I want to see the label's identity and mission, so that I understand what PlayReggaeMusic.ai is.
ExpectedBehavior: Hero section displays heading and tagline, always rendered regardless of catalog state.

UserStory: As a public visitor, I want to see a promoted release, so that I can discover new music.
ExpectedBehavior: Fetches first release via listReleases(); displays link to release page if available, else section hidden; shows title and catalog number.

UserStory: As a public visitor, I want to see a featured artist, so that I can discover creators.
ExpectedBehavior: Fetches first artist via listArtists(); displays link to artist page with bio if available, else section hidden.

UserStory: As a public visitor, I want to know releases are AI-created, so that I understand the provenance.
ExpectedBehavior: AiBadge renders AI-generated music text with accessible label; shown on home hero and all release pages.

UserStory: As a public visitor, I want to browse all label artists, so that I can discover performers.
ExpectedBehavior: Fetches artists via listArtists(); renders card grid with name and bio; error/loading/empty states.

UserStory: As a public visitor, I want to see artist details and photo, so that I can learn about them.
ExpectedBehavior: Fetches artist via getArtist(artistId); displays name, optional photo from /preview path, bio; error/loading states; 404 if not found.

UserStory: As a public visitor, I want to follow artists on Spotify/Apple Music/YouTube/Instagram, so that I can connect with them.
ExpectedBehavior: Renders filtered link list with human labels; links open in new tab.

UserStory: As a public visitor, I want to see all releases by an artist, so that I can browse their discography.
ExpectedBehavior: Fetches via listReleasesByArtist(artistId); renders card grid or empty state; links to release detail pages.

UserStory: As a public visitor, I want to see release metadata, so that I understand the recording.
ExpectedBehavior: Displays catalog number, title, and AI-generated badge; fetches via getRelease(releaseId).

UserStory: As a public visitor, I want to preview tracks before buying, so that I can judge the music.
ExpectedBehavior: Fetches via listTracksByRelease(releaseId); renders ordered list with title/duration/HTML audio element; preview URL via previewUrl() from /preview bucket; loading/error states.

UserStory: As a public visitor, I want to purchase a release, so that I can own the music.
ExpectedBehavior: Button calls onBuy(productId) -> createCheckout(); shows loading Starting checkout; if fixtures enabled shows inline confirmation without redirect; in prod redirects to Polar URL; displays formatted USD price.

UserStory: As a public visitor, I want to understand purchase failures, so that I can retry.
ExpectedBehavior: Displays error alert if createCheckout() fails with message Could not start checkout. Please try again.

UserStory: As a public visitor, I want to understand usage terms, so that I know what I can do with purchased music.
ExpectedBehavior: Renders two-line note: AI_GENERATED_DISCLOSURE + PERSONAL_LICENSE_PLACEHOLDER (owner to supply binding wording); appears on release buy section.

UserStory: As a public visitor, I want to navigate the site, so that I can reach different sections.
ExpectedBehavior: Nav renders links to /, /artists, /releases (stub), /shop (stub), /admin; home link uses LabelMark icon.
ErrorsFound: Nav links to /releases and /shop but App.tsx defines no matching route (only /releases/:releaseId). Both fall through the catch-all route and silently render the Home page - two of five nav items mislead the user. Logistical/UX defect.
Notes: Added src/pages/Releases.tsx + route /releases in App.tsx; removed dead /shop nav link (releases ARE the storefront). Guard test added in App.test.tsx asserts no dangling nav link and that /releases renders the index, not Home.

ExpectedBehavior: Lists pending approvals via listPendingApprovals(); shows tool name + argsSummary; empty shows No actions are pending approval.

ExpectedBehavior: Button per approval calls approve(approvalId); shows Approving; disabled while busy; refreshes list after.

UserStory: As a non-admin, I want to be denied access, so that only owner can view distribution status.

UserStory: As a non-admin, I want to be denied access, so that only owner can view royalty data.
ExpectedBehavior: AdminRoyalties.tsx checks watchAdminSession; displays Admin sign-in required if not authed.

ExpectedBehavior: Table lists statements via listRoyaltyStatements(); columns ArtistName/Period/Gross/Deductions/RecoupmentApplied/Net; Net = Gross - Deductions - Recoupment.

ExpectedBehavior: AgentConsole.tsx checks watchAdminSession; displays Admin sign-in required if not authed.

UserStory: As the owner, I want to specify a task for the autonomous agent, so that I can direct its work.
ExpectedBehavior: Textarea prefilled with DEFAULT_PROMPT; allows freeform instruction entry.

ExpectedBehavior: Button calls trigger(prompt) -> runAgent(prompt); shows Running; disabled while running.

ExpectedBehavior: Ordered list displays transcript entries with role and content; fixtures mode shows CANNED_TRANSCRIPT; prod calls runAgent() for live output.
